jobs.title: Senior Backend Software Engineer (m/f/d), Rust – AI-first E-commerce Tech
jobs.description:
Since 2018, we’ve become one of Google’s largest CSS Premium Partners, powering Shopping ads for 1,000+ customers across 20,000+ Merchant Centres in Europe.

Fully self-funded, profitable and still expanding, we’re a strong and supportive team with a stable foundation. Now we’re looking for a new colleague who wants to be part of it for the long run: an engineer who gets a goal rather than a ticket, builds with AI as a natural part of the job, and takes ownership from idea to production.

Why adstrong

  • 100% remote: work from anywhere in the EU, with flexible hours and no weekend or night work.

  • No process chaos: documentation and procedures are well-structured and digital.

  • No politics: we encourage proactive decisions and make ours within 24 hours.

  • Stable and growing: a fully self-funded, fast-growing company with no external investors.

  • Small, skilled team: a hands-on tech team of around 6 people.

  • Great working culture: supportive colleagues who help each other and share knowledge openly.

  • AI-first: coding agents are how we build, and your judgement is what matters.

  • Attractive compensation: plus all the equipment you need.

  • Missing anything? Mention it in your application, and we’ll see if we can make it happen.

What you will do

  • Build AI-first: plan with AI, drive coding agents and review their output with a critical eye.

  • Get a goal, not a ticket: work directly with colleagues on the business side to gather requirements, align on the solution and build it into working software.

  • Make sound architecture and data-model decisions, keeping our systems fast and reliable as we scale.

  • Take ownership of existing applications and build new solutions for our affiliate business.

  • Design and develop event-driven backend systems that handle large volumes of product and campaign data, mostly in Rust and partly in Python.

  • Own your topics end to end and keep the team and stakeholders in the loop along the way.

What you bring

  • Experience contributing to a strong engineering culture, e.g. through code reviews, knowledge sharing, or improving team tools and ways of working.

  • Daily hands-on work with coding agents: you plan with AI, delegate the implementation and know how to review what comes back, including more complex workflows like one model writing code while another reviews it.

  • Strong architectural awareness: you know which components and infrastructure to use for which problem, and how to structure what you build.

  • Rust experience, or curiosity about it and readiness to make it your main language, as most of our backend is written in it. C or C++ experience is a strong alternative.

  • Experience solving problems close to ours, ideally in e-commerce, affiliate marketing, Google Shopping, Google Ads or other data-heavy web platforms. Our business team will help you build the domain knowledge.

  • Experience with event-driven systems (e.g. Kafka, AWS SQS/SNS or similar)

  • A solid grasp of the full engineering process: requirements, design, trade-offs, testing and maintainability

  • Mid- or senior-level experience. We care more about how you think and work than about years on paper. Our business team will help you build the domain knowledge.

  • A Bachelor’s degree in computer science or a related field.

  • Business-fluent English (C1).

Our stack: Rust (plus some Python) on the backend, and TypeScript / Next.js on the frontend. The frontend is owned by our frontend engineers, so experience there is a plus but not required.

How you work

  • You communicate clearly and proactively. You’re comfortable talking to business colleagues, ask the right questions early, share progress without being asked and explain technical trade-offs in plain language.

  • You value good engineering culture. We improve as a team, so honest feedback matters to us, and so do your ideas for improving our team culture, tools and the way we work in IT.

  • You organize yourself. Give you a goal, and you’ll plan the work, set priorities and follow through, without needing a detailed ticket for every step.

  • You’re genuinely curious. You enjoy digging into new topics, including the business side, and you keep learning as tools and AI evolve.

  • You take ownership. You care about the outcome, not just the code, and you drive your topics forward instead of waiting for direction.

If you match most of these points and want to help shape the technology behind one of Europe’s leading CSS providers, we’d love to hear from you. There’s no classic coding test in our process. Instead, we’ll talk through a realistic goal together and see how you approach it with AI.

Apply now if you want stability without standing still: a place to learn, grow and stay.

jobs.title: Senior Marketing Manager Tech Startup f/m/d
jobs.description:
About PULT

PULT is the Workplace Presence & Visitor Platform for fast growing companies. We help IT, Workplace and People teams understand who is actually in the office, run compliant visitor management, and make better decisions about their space.

We are a Hamburg-based B2B SaaS company, backed by strong investors, with customers like VEVO, Wellhub and SG Fleet. We are post-seed, growing fast, and preparing the next stage of the company. Marketing is one of the biggest levers we have, and it still has a lot of untouched potential. That is where you come in.

Your first months at Pult

We are hiring a senior marketing / growth manager: one person who owns the full funnel, end to end, and scales what works. A bold, AI-native generalist who wants the whole board.

PULT is growing fast and opening international markets. You will turn it into a repeatable, measurable engine, and you will have the mandate, the budget and the backing to do it.

If you have been waiting for the role where you finally get to run marketing rather than a slice of it, this is it.

Your mission:

Demand generation

  • Plan and run paid campaigns across LinkedIn, Google and the channels you discover next, with full ownership of budget and ROI

  • Own the website and conversion funnel together with our web agency: messaging, landing pages, experiments

  • Build the organic engine: SEO, AI search visibility, content that IT and People leaders actually want to read

  • Run our webinar programme and turn it into a reliable pipeline source

Brand and storytelling

  • Sharpen PULT's positioning and make sure every touchpoint tells the same bold story

  • Produce standout content: campaigns, videos, case studies, product launches, founder and customer stories

  • Set a high bar for design and copy, and hold the team and agencies to it

Offline and events

  • Take PULT to the events that matter in DACH and the UK, from trade fairs to our own customer dinners and roundtables

  • Run account-based campaigns into our target accounts, online and offline, together with Sales

Engine and scale

  • Own the marketing stack (HubSpot, analytics, AI tooling) and the data behind it: attribution, CAC, MQL growth, pipeline contribution

  • Use AI as a force multiplier for research, content, creative and ops, and build the agents and workflows that let a small team move like a big one

  • Define the marketing roadmap, report on results to the leadership team, and hire the first marketing team members as we scale

What the role requires

  • A generalist with range. 3+ years in B2B SaaS marketing, ideally in a scale-up, with hands-on experience across paid, online and offline channels. You have run campaigns, written the copy, briefed the designer and read the dashboard yourself.

  • AI-native. You already work with AI every day: for research, content, creative, analysis and automation. You see where the tools are heading and you build with them, not around them.

  • High agency. You do not wait for a brief. You get excited by ambitious goals, find the path, and ship.

  • A storyteller with taste. Exceptional writing in English (German is a strong plus) and a sharp eye for design. You know the difference between content that fills a calendar and content that moves people.

  • Bold. You would rather launch something people talk about than something safe that nobody notices. You bring ideas we have not thought of.

  • ROI first. You think in pipeline, not impressions. You are comfortable with budgets, CAC, conversion rates and the conversation with Sales about lead quality.

  • International. You have experience in DACH and / or UKI market. You excited about expanding into new markets.

  • A builder. You want to be the leading marketing hire, expand on the foundations, and grow into leading a team.

Benefits

This is a remote-first position. You will have access to career training to support your professional development. A company laptop is provided for your daily work. Stay active with a sport membership. Enjoy flexible working hours. Company stock options give you a stake in the company's growth. Paid co-working options are also available.

Compensation

EUR 50,000–65,000 per year

Join PULT

If you match most of these requirements and are ready to shape the future of workplaces across the world, we encourage you to apply. You will be joining an early-stage startup where your contributions directly impact growth and product adoption.

Founded in 2008 and profitable since 2014, our annual revenue is in the hundreds of millions USD and millions use our browser on Mac, Windows, iOS, and Android, our search engine, and the DuckDuckGo subscription. We also offer private, useful, and optional AI, including Duck.ai, which lets you chat privately with ChatGPT, Claude, and other AIs, all in one place.

 

Our culture of trust, inclusivity, and empowered project management underpins everything we do, where each team member takes full ownership of their projects, from scoping and execution to postmortem. If you're seeking end-to-end ownership of your work, you've come to the right place!

Your Team and Role

Working on the Marketing and Communications Functional Team, you'll help shape how millions of people hear about DuckDuckGo, lead projects, and own key ongoing work.

 

As a Social Media And Communications Manager, you'll write social media copy, manage social media mentions and communities, coordinate proactive announcements, manage incoming press requests, regularly report out and keep track of key performance metrics and work on related projects. You'll be the directly responsible individual (DRI) on your own projects from scoping through postmortem, collaborating closely with product, design, legal, support, and leadership.

 

Example projects include:

  • Announcing DuckDuckGo products and features, across press, social, and community channels.

  • Running a multi-week social campaign to raise awareness of a product area, from measuring the baseline and planning content through weekly reporting and recommendations.

About You

  • 6+ years in communications, including PR and social media, ideally in tech.

  • Excellent writing skills, with the ability to explain products clearly, without jargon.

  • Hands-on social media experience, including content development and community management on X, Facebook, Reddit, LinkedIn, Instagram, TikTok, Threads, and Bluesky.

  • Media relations experience, including pitching journalists, handling inquiries, and building press relationships.

  • Experience measuring social media and earned media reach, engagement, sentiment, and campaign impact and turning results into insightful reports.

About Tracium

https://www.linkedin.com/company/tracium/

Tracium builds AI-assisted technical documentation software that turns complex manuals and engineering documents into structured, traceable information. Our initial focus is maritime, with applications across manufacturing, aerospace, and defence.

We combine document intelligence with S1000D authoring to help technical teams extract maintenance information, create documentation, and verify AI-generated suggestions against their sources.

Your role

You will own the AI capabilities behind our document intelligence platform—from understanding complex PDFs to extracting information that engineers can review and use.

What you’ll do

  • Build pipelines for document parsing, OCR, layout understanding, and extraction from text, tables, and diagrams.

  • Develop retrieval and AI workflows for technical question answering and maintenance information extraction.

  • Design structured outputs with validation and references to source documents.

  • Build evaluation datasets and measure extraction accuracy, retrieval quality, and unsupported outputs.

  • Improve model performance, processing speed, and cost across cloud and private deployments.

  • Work with product and engineering colleagues to bring prototypes into production.

What you bring

  • Experience delivering AI or machine learning systems into production.

  • Strong Python and software engineering skills.

  • Practical experience with LLMs, structured extraction, retrieval, and evaluation.

  • An understanding of document processing challenges, including imperfect scans and complex layouts.

  • The ability to investigate failures systematically and make clear technical trade-offs.

  • Clear communication in English.

Useful additional experience

  • Technical manuals, industrial documentation

  • Multimodal models, open-source model deployment, or GPU inference.

  • Private, on-premises, or restricted-network environments.

Why join Tracium?

Help shape the core AI architecture of an early-stage product, work directly with the founders, and solve document problems with clear operational value.

Follow our journey
Follow Tracium on LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/company/tracium/ for product updates, engineering insights, and future opportunities.

Apply

Apply with the button on the page, attach your CV or professional profile and a brief example of an AI system you have built. Public repositories, demos, or a short technical write-up are welcome.

We welcome applicants of all backgrounds. You do not need to meet every listed requirement to apply.

jobs.title: Senior Sales Manager & Team Lead, EMEA (m/f/x)
jobs.description:
UP42 was founded in 2019 with a clear purpose: to transform how organizations order, access, and analyze Earth observation data. Our platform brings together the world's leading geospatial providers, and offers a single touchpoint to access, manage, and process data at scale. From vegetation management and infrastructure monitoring to disaster response, UP42 helps organizations across industries find solutions to complex problems through Earth observation. Our expert support team and detailed documentation guide our users through every step. Since July 2025, UP42 has been a part of Neo Space Group.

We are looking for a Senior Sales Manager & Team Lead, EMEA  (m/f/x) to join our Sales team in Berlin (hybrid) or remotely in Germany. Our EMEA team is growing into large European enterprises, and our enterprise go-to-market is still maturing. In this role you sell to those enterprises yourself, and you coach our Sales Managers in the region. Most of your results will come from your own sales, and you will work closely with Marketing and Customer Success teams.

What you will do:

  • Drive strategic pipeline and account growth with large European enterprises in energy, finance, insurance and infrastructure.

  • Win and grow strategic enterprise opportunities with our Earth Observation platform.

  • Build relationships with some of Europe's largest enterprise accounts.

  • Deliver your annual sales targets with a healthy and repeatable enterprise pipeline.

  • Coach and mentor your team members, and help them capture and manage complex enterprise opportunities.

  • Improve deal quality, deal progression and forecasting across the EMEA team.

  • Strengthen enterprise selling discipline as our enterprise go-to-market matures.


Here is a good summary of what we are looking for:

  • Significant years of sales experience within the geospatial industry, including Earth observation, remote sensing, GIS platform sales, satellite imagery, LiDAR, or adjacent technologies

  • Proven success selling data and/or platforms into enterprise customers, including managing long sales cycles and complex buying committees

  • Enterprise sales experience in the European market

  • Strong track record of sourcing, structuring, and closing high-value deals while carrying and consistently achieving quota

  • Willingness to act as player-coach and to mentor others

  • Ability to guide and develop experienced sellers

  • Track record of planning pipeline and delivering deals in line with forecast

  • Knowledge of remote sensing and geospatial markets in Europe, with vertical expertise in energy, finance, insurance or infrastructure

Bonus points if you bring:

  • Team management experience

Let us tell you why UP42 is a good choice:

  • Let's disrupt the industry: You get the chance to shape the state-of-the-art geospatial processing platform and create a completely new planetary perspective.

  • Let's stay flexible: We practice a hybrid working model - you can choose when to work from the comfort of your home or join your colleagues in our modern office in the heart of Kreuzberg, or even from a global place of your choice up to 90 days per year.

  • Let's win as a team: We're an inspiring international team working in a fun and productive environment.

  • Let's be fair: We offer a competitive salary package and other perks such as wellbeing initiatives, sponsored fitness subscriptions, educational budget for your personal development and public transportation discount - just to name a few.

  • Let's enjoy the good side of life: Gather in regular team events as well as our global company parties twice a year.

  • Let's think outside of the box: There are challenges and enough space for creativity and taking ownership.

Does this sound like a good next step into your geospatial career? If so, we look forward to receiving your application in English.

Our culture is one of belonging, where everyone feels welcome and where differences are celebrated. We seek to recruit the best talent regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background and/or belief—and strongly encourage people from underrepresented groups to apply. We also value more than the skills and experiences outlined in this job description. Even if you think you only fill 60% of the requirements for this role - we would still like to consider your application.

jobs.title: Disputes & Chargebacks Manager
jobs.description:
At Vio we believe booking accommodation should feel smart, fair, and effortless — never overwhelming or unclear.

As one of the world’s fastest-growing travel tech platforms, we help millions of users make smarter travel decisions by comparing stays across 100+ booking sites — so they can find the perfect place, at the best price, anywhere in the world. We cut through the noise and complexity of hotel and vacation rental booking, surfacing real value with clarity, transparency, and full support. No tricks. No confusion. Just great stays — booked with confidence. With operations in 100+ markets and growing fast, our mission is to reshape how people discover and book accommodation through technology travelers can trust.

We’re looking for an experienced Disputes & Chargebacks Manager to own and continuously improve our disputes function end to end.

You’ll be accountable for two closely connected areas: dispute management and chargeback representment.

On dispute management, you’ll own how we identify and respond to dispute trends, improve prevention, strengthen evidence, and coordinate effectively with internal teams and external partners.

On chargeback representment, you’ll own the operational health and performance of the process including case quality, deadlines, win rates, team effectiveness, partner performance and automation.

The role requires operational ownership with the goal of improving dispute outcomes while scaling the function efficiently as volumes grow.

☑️ What you’ll do

  • Run the dispute operation day to day, making sure cases are handled accurately and on time

  • Manage volume, workload and escalations across the team and our outsourced partners, holding partners to clear targets on quality, speed and cost

  • Review representments and evidence, coach the team, and set the quality bar

  • Decide when to fight, accept or escalate a dispute based on evidence, value and effort

  • Analyse won and lost cases to sharpen strategy, and flag unusual dispute or fraud trends quickly

  • Work with Customer Support, Product, Finance, Payments and Fraud to reduce avoidable disputes through changes to fraud rules, refund policies, communication and the product

  • Redesign workflows around automation, including triage, evidence gathering, deadline tracking and AI-assisted drafting with human review

  • Partner with Data and Engineering to build reliable reporting on dispute performance

🔎 Who you are

  • You have 5+ years of hands-on experience in disputes and chargebacks, including writing representments yourself

  • You know dispute lifecycles, reason codes, evidence requirements and representment strategy in depth

  • You have led a disputes and chargebacks function, including team performance and operational delivery

  • You find trends, risks and opportunities in data, and turn them into concrete process changes

  • You have set quality standards and coached people to meet them

  • Nice to have: experience in travel, hospitality or marketplaces where the company is the merchant of record; managing outsourced dispute teams; scaling a manual operation with tooling, AI or automation; and working with card scheme monitoring programmes and chargeback-ratio thresholds

In your first months, you’ll work live cases yourself, set a trusted baseline for performance, and launch the first automation initiative. By month six, we expect measurable improvement in win rates, quality and cost, and a working loop with other teams that prevents avoidable disputes

Why join us now?

  • We are one of the most innovative and fastest-growing accommodation booking platforms in the world today, having grown our bookings 30x between 2017 and 2025, and catering to the needs of over 100 million unique visitors worldwide each year. We do that by harnessing the power of advanced algorithms and an innovative suite of power features and managed to overcome the corona crisis remarkably fast;

  • The mobile applications (iOS and Android) we launched in 2023 are already a big success, reaching 5 million installs with great customer reviews, as we are beginning to build Vio as the brand for value-seeking travellers worldwide;

  • We are a passionate and diverse team of tech enthusiasts and creatives with a commitment and focus on the traveler above all else - and it shows in our industry-leading TrustPilot score;

  • We place huge importance on rewarding our employees for the value they generate by giving Stock Appreciation Rights to all employees.

Do you want to know if Vio is the right place for you? Find out by reading about the attitude that thrives at Vio.

What we offer:

  • Plenty of chances to learn and grow within an open, diverse culture which promotes knowledge sharing, trust and transparency;

  • A great compensation package, perks and benefits (including significant stock appreciation rights);

  • Flexible time off (take as many holidays as you need) and a chance to work remotely;

  • You will be part of a highly international team that enjoys working, eating and playing together in one of the best office locations in Amsterdam;

  • We value good food and offer catered lunches from various cuisines, great coffee, and the occasional barbecue in our garden;

  • We enjoy getting together to celebrate our wins with company events in Amsterdam and abroad;

  • A budget for your dream home office;

  • Access to free mental health support via OpenUp.
